summary: Frontend-only e2e UI testing of Lucenta restaurant site. All requested data-testid elements rendered, menu tab switching works for all 5 categories (antipasti/pasta/pizza/secondi/dolci), smooth-scroll anchor navigation works for hero-menu-cta and nav-menu-link (scrollY=2073 to #menu), bento gallery has 4 tiles, contact section shows map iframe + address/hours/phone/email + phone-cta, footer renders with Instagram & Facebook social links, mobile-menu-toggle opens drawer with all 4 nav links + reserve-cta-mobile at 390px viewport. No broken images (6/6 loaded). No console errors. Hero heading 'Fuoco, memoria, farina.' verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Header logo points to href='#top' which only resolves because Hero section has id='top'; works but slightly unconventional (consider href='#' or scroll-to-top handler).
Footer 'Back to top' uses '#top' anchor — consistent with Hero id, fine.
Iframe Google Maps embed uses public URL (no API key) — acceptable for marketing site but be aware of Google ToS for production.

All components use single useReveal() ref attached to <section> wrapper, but child elements use bare className='reveal' which depends on parent .visible class — verify CSS handles this correctly (visual reveal worked in tests).
No 404 route catch-all in App.js — only '/' is defined; consider a NotFound route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend marketing site only — no backend mutations. All data-testids requested in review are present and working. Mobile breakpoint md=768px. Menu tabs switch active list via React state (useState). IntersectionObserver reveal animation requires ~1s wait after scroll.
